sector.why: Neutral. Yield and defensive earnings wanted under Component 1 regime (rates-led late cycle: Richard's view 16-Sep-26, rates and yields rising, inflation high, consumer confidence low, downside skew; sources absent), offset by leverage in a rising-yield world. geography.why: Overweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): the Swiss index is among those Goldman (19 Oct) names as rallying alongside non-AI and low-beta exposures, which is the rotation this row was set on; the Swiss National Bank was not re-read this week, so last week's 'not hiking' stands. Relative strength is not graded by country. Counter-case unchanged: the franc takes 2 to 3 points a year off a Swiss exporter's reported profit (Sonova memo), and five of the Swiss Pool names are semiconductor names inside an Underweight sector. Back to C if the SNB joins the hikers or the franc reverses.
